recovered_elements.text: Nikhil Kumar
Bengaluru, India | 7631000760 | nikhilkumarjha311@gmail.com | linkedin.com/in/nikhil-kumar-916b41175/
SUMMARY

Senior Business Analyst with 5+ years of experience across BFSI, Regulatory Compliance, Digital Transformation, HR-Tech and AI-driven solutions, with strong experience in translating complex business requirements into functional specifications and technology deliverables.

Currently experienced in supporting Citi Bank programs through Genpact, working across Risk & Compliance, Regulatory Transformation, Data Governance, Control Governance and Business Process Transformation. Strong expertise in requirements elicitation, BRD/FRD/SRS documentation, user stories, process mapping, gap analysis, stakeholder management, UAT and requirements traceability.

Experienced in working with senior stakeholders including VPs, AVPs and Directors, as well as cross-functional teams across Business, Technology, Data Engineering, QA and Analytics. Strong understanding of Agile/Scrum, Kanban and Waterfall delivery methodologies, with hands-on exposure to JIRA, Confluence, SQL, Power BI, Tableau, Visio and Lucidchart.
EDUCATION
Biju Patnaik University of Technology (BPUT) Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech) – Computer Science
CBSE Class XII – Science
CBSE Class X – Science
EXPERIENCE
Business Analyst – BFSI | Citi Bank GENPACT
Dec 2024 – Apr 2026 Bengaluru

Supported Citi Bank's Digital Transformation and Regulatory Compliance initiatives, working with business and technology stakeholders to translate regulatory and business requirements into actionable technology deliverables.

Led end-to-end requirement engineering, conducting requirement elicitation sessions with 15+ global stakeholders and converting complex business requirements into BRDs, FRDs, user stories and functional specifications.

Worked within the Risk & Compliance / Control Governance environment, supporting Second Line of Defense (2LOD) activities across business functions and ensuring alignment with governance and regulatory requirements.
Translated regulatory requirements covering areas such as BSA/AML, KYC and Dodd-Frank into business requirements, process changes and Agile user stories.
Performed AS-IS / TO-BE analysis, gap analysis and process modelling using Visio and Lucidchart to identify process inefficiencies, control gaps and opportunities for operational improvement.

Collaborated with 1LOD, 2LOD and 3LOD stakeholders, Data Engineering, QA and Analytics teams to drive requirements clarification, issue resolution and delivery across geographically distributed teams.
Managed 5 concurrent workstreams within an Agile/Scrum environment, supporting sprint planning, backlog grooming, requirement prioritization and delivery tracking.
Maintained the Requirements Traceability Matrix (RTM) to ensure complete traceability between business requirements, functional requirements, test scenarios and delivered functionality.
• Planned and coordinated UAT activities, including test scenario preparation, business validation, defect triage
and stakeholder sign-off, contributing to zero critical defect leakage into production.
Performed SQL-based data validation to verify data accuracy and integrity for regulatory reporting and governance requirements.
Supported Data Governance and Data Quality initiatives, including data lineage documentation, data mapping and validation of critical reporting data.
Conducted Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for business and process issues and coordinated with relevant stakeholders to define corrective actions.
Developed Power BI and Tableau dashboards for program leadership, improving visibility into project health and reducing manual status-reporting effort by approximately 40%.
Managed stakeholder communication with VP, AVP and Director-level stakeholders, ensuring timely escalation, decision-making and resolution of project risks and issues.
Supported risk and issue management, change management and delivery governance across multiple transformation initiatives.
Business Analyst – ERP | HRMS & Payroll Management System AMAZE INC
Aug 2022 – Sep 2024 Bengaluru
Led business analysis activities for a cloud-based HRMS and Payroll ERP, covering requirements gathering, process analysis, functional documentation, testing and implementation.
Conducted requirement elicitation sessions with business stakeholders and translated HR and Finance requirements into BRDs, functional specifications, user stories and process flows.
Developed AS-IS / TO-BE process maps and wireframes to define future-state workflows for payroll automation and employee self-service modules.
Collaborated with Product, UI/UX and Engineering teams to clarify requirements, resolve functional gaps and ensure alignment between business expectations and technical implementation.
Managed product backlog and supported sprint planning, backlog grooming and prioritization within a Scrum environment using JIRA.
Coordinated UAT cycles, including test case preparation, defect triage, business validation and stakeholder sign-off.
Analysed payroll calculation processes and supported implementation of automated calculation logic, contributing to a 30% reduction in manual payroll errors.
Worked closely with cross-functional teams throughout the product lifecycle from requirements and design through development, testing and go-live.
Business Analyst – AI Hiring Automation Project RCHILLI INC
Feb 2022 – Aug 2022 Mohali • Gathered and analysed business and functional requirements for a SaaS-based AI-driven recruitment and hiring
automation platform.
Worked on requirements related to Resume Parser and automated candidate data extraction, focusing on improving accuracy and usability of candidate information.
Developed functional specifications, workflow diagrams and process documentation for automated recruitment processes.
Collaborated with technical teams to translate business requirements into system functionality and identify process improvements.
Analysed recruitment workflows and supported the design of automated candidate matching, screening and data extraction processes.
TECHNICAL SKILLS

Business Analysis & Requirement Engineering Requirement Elicitation & Stakeholder Management BRD / FRD / SRS Documentation User Stories & Acceptance Criteria Functional & Business Requirements AS-IS / TO-BE Process Mapping

Gap Analysis & Process Optimization Business Process Modelling BPMN / UML / Process Flow Design Regulatory & Compliance Transformation Risk & Control Governance Data Governance & Data Quality Data Lineage & Regulatory Reporting UAT Planning & Execution Test Cases & Defect Management Requirements Traceability Matrix (RTM) Root Cause Analysis Agile / Scrum / Kanban / Waterfall Sprint Planning & Backlog Grooming Project & Delivery Management Cross-functional & Global Stakeholder Management SQL & Data Validation Power BI / Tableau / Advanced Excel
CERTIFICATIONS
Google Data Analytics Professional Certificate Scrum Master & Agile Certification JIRA Certification
TOOLS & TECHNOLOGIES

Business Analysis: BRD, FRD, SRS, User Stories, Use Cases, Acceptance Criteria, RTM, Requirement Traceability, Gap Analysis Process & Modelling: MS Visio, Lucidchart, Miro, BPMN, UML, Process Flow, AS-IS / TO-BE Mapping Project & Agile: JIRA, Confluence, MS Project, Trello, Agile, Scrum, Kanban, Waterfall, Sprint Planning, Backlog Grooming Data & Analytics: SQL Server, Advanced Excel, VLOOKUP, Power Query, Power BI, Tableau Modern Technology: Generative AI, Prompt Engineering, Agentic AI, API Documentation, Microservices Architecture, Cloud Adoption Productivity: Microsoft Office 365
